title: PNOE’s new face mask wants to make lab-grade breath testing a self-serve affair
slides: Can a mask replace your lab's breath test?
PNOE's new mask promises lab-grade results, self-serve
But accuracy depends on how you wear it
You could test metabolism at home, no technician
Try one breath test yourself and compare
thread_text:
1. Your lab test's replacement?

A new mask claims to measure metabolism with lab-grade accuracy. If it works, you won't need to schedule a breath test ever again.

2. Wear it wrong, waste your money

PNOE's mask is self-serve, but accuracy depends entirely on how you put it on. A loose seal means unreliable numbers you might act on.

3. No technician, no waiting room

You could test metabolism at home on your own schedule. That removes the biggest barrier: finding someone to administer the test.

4. Compare it yourself

Try one breath test with the mask and one at a lab. Same conditions, same day if possible. Then decide if the convenience is worth the risk.
